answer: Planning allows LLM agents to set goals and determine actions, memory enables them to retain and use past experiences, and tools help them interact with their environment and other agents. These components work together to create believable and interactive behaviors. The combination of LLM, memory, planning, and reflection mechanisms supports complex decision-making and social interactions.
